livingCosts.notes: Sunway 'Experience Sunway' living-expenses estimate for international students (undated, read 2026-09-30). Housing: Sunway hostels RM420-RM2,300 per month (midpoint), rental includes water, electricity and internet; off-campus rooms RM500-RM3,000. Food: RM1,200 per month (3 basic meals). Transport: no figure given (campus is walkable, BRT/LRT nearby). Personal: entertainment allowance RM100-RM200 (midpoint RM150); books and stationery RM200-RM500 'per course or semester' are listed but not budgeted here. Sunway's overall figure is 'around RM2,000' a month for food and accommodation. Monthly figures with no term basis, so 12 months.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Computer Science
programmes.notes: Estimated annual course fee (Year 2026): RM39,800 for Malaysian students, USD9,779 for international students, which Sunway says is only an indicative conversion and must be paid 'in RM equivalent'. Sunway publishes no separate RM rate for international students; the RM figure on the page is recorded (USD9,779 x 4.07 = RM39,800), so treat the international figure as the same RM fee plus exchange-rate risk. One-off = international enrolment fee RM742 (incl. 6% SST) + EMGS student pass processing RM3,300 (Sunway 'Apply Today' page). 3-year programme (9 semesters). Excludes 6% SST on tuition for non-Malaysians. Not stated to be fixed for the cohort.
